This is a frozen-design assumption that did not hold on the test split.

On AXIS-G2-RETEST it fires on test rows oos_006, oos_010, oos_014 (plus calibration row oos_023). C7 does not fire on any applicable row, which explains the liveness predicate failure on the applicable half.
